Name: Tool Lifespan
Author: slpOff
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
This mod adds a durability system to selected vanilla tools, along with a shop and repair overhaul.
Tools no longer last forever. You must manage, repair, and replace them as you progress.
[line]
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI[/*]
[*]Install Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[*]Extract this mod into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[size=4] Durability System[/size]

[list]
[*]Supported tools have durability[/*]
[*]Durability decreases on use[/*]
[*]Durability is tracked per player (multiplayer safe)[/*]
[*]Durability is saved in player save data[/*]
[/list]When durability reaches 0:
[list]
[*]Tool can be destroyed[/*]
[*]Tool can downgrade by one tier and restore durability[/*]
[*]Or tool can apply penalties (e.g. increased stamina usage)[/*]
[/list](All behaviors are configurable)
[line]
[size=4] Supported Tools[/size]

[list]
[*]Axe[/*]
[*]Pickaxe[/*]
[*]Hoe[/*]
[*]Watering Can[/*]
[*]Pan[/*]
[*]Trash Can[/*]
[/list]Not supported:
[list]
[*]Weapons[/*]
[*]Scythe[/*]
[*]Tools added by other mods[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4] Tool Purchase[/size]

[list]
[*]Tools can be purchased from NPCs[/*]
[*]Shops only sell [b]basic-tier tools[/b][/*]
[/list]Material cost (basic tools):
[list]
[*]Stone x25[/*]
[/list]Special rule:
[list]
[*]Basic Pickaxe purchase is limited to [b]3 per day[/b][/*]
[*]Purchase count is saved and does not reset when reopening the shop[/*]
[*]When limit is reached, the item is removed from the shop immediately[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4] Repair System[/size]

[list]
[*]Clint can both upgrade and repair tools[/*]
[*]When selecting the upgrade menu, you can choose between upgrading or repairing[/*]
[/list]Repair behavior:
[list]
[*]Tool tier remains the same[/*]
[*]Durability is fully restored[/*]
[*]Uses upgrade system flow internally[/*]
[/list]Repair cost:
[list]
[*]Gold (fixed per tier)
[list]
[*]Basic → 1000g[/*]
[*]Copper → 3000g[/*]
[*]Iron → 8000g[/*]
[*]Gold → 18000g[/*]
[*]Iridium → 33000g[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Materials
[list]
[*]Basic → Stone x25[/*]
[*]Copper → Copper Bar x5[/*]
[*]Iron → Iron Bar x5[/*]
[*]Gold → Gold Bar x5[/*]
[*]Iridium → Iridium Bar x5[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][line]
UI
[list]
[*]Durability is displayed as a bar on tool icons[/*]
[/list]Color states:
[list]
[*]Green → High durability[/*]
[*]Yellow → Medium[/*]
[*]Red → Low[/*]
[*]Gray → Broken[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading] GMCM Support[/heading]
Fully configurable via Generic Mod Config Menu.
Available Settings
[list]
[*]Enable Durability[/*]
[*]Show Durability Bar[/*]
[*]Destroy On Zero[/*]
[*]Downgrade On Zero[/*]
[*]Zero Durability Penalty[/*]
[*]Destroy Existing Tool On Purchase[/*]
[*]Sell Previous Tool Tiers[/*]
[*]Repair Cost Multiplier[/*]
[*]Decay values per tier[/*]
[*]Max durability per tier[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Notes[/heading]
[list]
[*]Existing tools automatically receive durability[/*]
[*]Config changes immediately affect durability limits[/*]
[*]Multiplayer safe (each player has independent durability)[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Known Issues[/heading]
[list]
[*]Tool removal on purchase may not always work correctly[/*]
[*]Clint repair flow may leave edge-case inventory inconsistencies[/*]
[/list]For more stable gameplay, enabling [b]Destroy On Zero[/b] is recommended.
